title: Makapix Club - Pixel Art Club
shortDescription: Create animated pixel art, share it, and remix work from the community.
fullDescription:
Makapix Club is a pixel-art community with a complete animated pixel-art editor built in. Draw, animate, publish and remix all in one app.

THE CLUB
 • Browse feeds of fresh pixel art from the community
 • Follow artists, react, comment
 • Publish pixel art straight from the Makapix editor
 • Remix: open shared artworks in the editor, make them yours, post your take
 • Artists can attach their editable layers file, so you can build on the real source

THE EDITOR
 • Canvases up to 512×512, up to 1024 frames and 128 layers per frame
 • Pencil, eraser, fill, shapes, selections, and a full palette manager
 • Deep per-frame undo history
 • Import GIF, PNG, APNG, JPEG, BMP, and WebP
 • Export PNG, GIFs, lossless WebP
 • Works fully offline, no account needed to draw

MAKAPIX PLAYERS
 • Makapix players are physical displays that show artwork straight from the club
 • Art on a player updates live from the club

MADE FOR PIXEL ART LOVERS

Free, no ads, no data selling, no algorithm. The editor works without an account. Sign in to publish and take part in the community.

Languages: English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Русский, 日本語, and 简体中文.
